# Showdown
[color=#999999][italic]...is a real showdown, with many more guns than usual[/italic][/color]
Antagonists: [color=#ff0000]Traitors[/color]
Key Identities: [color=lime]Arms Dealer[/color] and [color=ruber]Mercenary[/color]
## Summary
There's no two ways to cut this one, an extensive amount of guns will quickly get into rotation with a great deal of firefights breaking out.
Try to stay on people's good sides, as any allies might be handing you weapons instead of lead. Likewise the Traitors will be doing the same, as while they are heavily armed as well they are greatly outnumbered.
Don't just fire the moment anything goes awry, because it is more than likely you could end up being framed and fired just as quickly.
